newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Victorias says audit uncovers loan anomaly.
newsitem.headline: Victorias says audit uncovers loan anomaly.

text.p: Cash-strapped Victorias Milling Company Inc (VMC) said on Monday an audit of its financial health indicated some of its officers may have been involved in a loan anomaly involving the firm's subsidiary.

"In the process of the due diligence being performed by J. Cunanan and Co commissioned by VMC's board, irregular issuances of refined sugar delivery orders in favour of North Negros Marketing Corporation by VMC officers were uncovered," chief executive officer Manuel Manalac said in a statement.
Philippine newspapers reported last week that some banks recently found they had been issued worthless collateral involving sugar stocks of VMC, a charge denied earlier by a senior VMC official.
North Negros is 51 percent owned by VMC.
